config.script:
# clearing out the following: the selection of the tag tree, the selected tag path, the
	# params for the binding-editor, and the 'items' custom property on the alarm-configurator
	# view (via the updateItems message handler; the 'items' custom property is used to sync 
	# the state of the tag tree between the large view and the small view); when the length of
	# the 'items' custom property becomes 0, the tag tree calls browseTags to refresh its list 
	# of tags (in the binding for the tag tree items on both the large view and small view)
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.lg.refresh')
	logger.debug('refreshing tag tree, clearing current select tag')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateItems",payload={'items':[]},scope='page')
	
	# If items param is empty currently (which the Tree items is pointing at in binding),
	# then the above sendMessage to updateItems will not cause the items param to change
	# in value (because the above sendMessage to updateItems sets items to be empty), and
	# because items param will not change, the binding on the Tree items will not re-fire
	# to get the tags. so, if items param is empty, call refreshBinding here.
	if len(self.view.params.items) == 0:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").refreshBinding('props.items')
	
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selection = []
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Tree").props.selectionData = []
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateTagPath", payload = {'path':'', 'selections':('',{})}, scope = "page")
	
	payload = {'name':'','prop':{},'displayName':''}
			
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateBindingEditor", payload = payload, scope = "page")
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateSelectedRow", payload = {'row':None}, scope = "page")

def clearSelected():
		"""
		If an alarm is selected in the alarm list and the user
			clicks on an item in the tag tree, then clear out
			the selection.
		"""
		if self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarms").getChild("Alarm Container").getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow != None:
			system.perspective.sendMessage("updateSelectedRow", payload = {'row':None}, scope = "page")
			self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarms").getChild("Alarm Container").getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow = None
	
	def sanitizeTree(element):
		"""
		A custom deep copy functon for dicts/lists that converts
			the Perspective property object wrappers to the
			Python equivalent.
			
		Args:
			element: The Perspective property object wrapper.
		
		Returns:
			A deep copy (Python equivalent) of the Perspective
			property object wrapper passed in (element).
		"""
		if hasattr(element, '__iter__'):
			if hasattr(element, 'keys'):
				return dict((k, sanitizeTree(element[k])) for k in element.keys())
			else:
				return list(sanitizeTree(x) for x in element)
		return element
	
	# before updating the tree items and the selected tag, check to
	# see if tagConfig is different than loadedTagConfig (if it is,
	# then that means that the user made some changes to the alarms,
	# and so we can display a warning message to make sure that the
	# user wants to change the current tag selection).
	
	tagConfig = sanitizeTree(self.view.params.tagConfig)
	loadedTagConfig = sanitizeTree(self.view.params.loadedTagConfig)
	
	if tagConfig == loadedTagConfig:
		self.updateTree(event)
	else:
		system.perspective.openPopup("changes-lost",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'title':'Warning','body':'The changes to the alarm config will be lost. Would you like to proceed?','id':'changes-lost','yesOrNo':True,'event':event},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)

onChange.script:
# when the breakpoint container switches from the small view to the large view, if
	# there is already an alarm selected, then this script ensures that the correct
	# row in the alarm list will be selected
	
	selectedRow = self.view.params.selectedRow
	if selectedRow != None and selectedRow != self.props.selection.selectedRow:
		import time
		time.sleep(0.3)
		self.props.selection.selectedRow = selectedRow
		self.props.selection.selectedColumn = 'name'

config.script:
import time
	
	def findAlarmIndex(alarmList,name):
		"""
		Utilizes the alarm name to find the row index of the
			alarm in the alarm list.
		
		Args:
			alarmList: List of alarms for this tag.
			name: Name of the alarm being searched.
		
		Returns:
			If the alarm name was found in alarmList, then
			the index of the alarm is returned. If the
			alarm name was not found in alarmList,
			then -1 is returned.
		"""
		for i, alarm in enumerate(alarmList):
			if alarm['name'] == name:
				return i
		return -1
	
	# user wants to add an alarm for the current tag
	
	if len(self.view.params.tagConfig.keys()) > 0:
		
		logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.lg.add')
		logger.debug('new alarm added; tagpath= ' + self.view.params.tagConfig['path'])
			
		# figuring out the name; if the tag has no alarms, name will be 'Alarm'; if tag has
		# alarms and one is called 'Alarm', then will try 'Alarm 1', 'Alarm 2', and so on
		# until a unique alarm name is found
		if 'alarms' in self.view.params.tagConfig.keys():
		
			alarms = list(self.view.params.tagConfig['alarms'])
	
			currAlarmNames = []
			for alarm in alarms:
				currAlarmNames.append(alarm['name'])
		
			if 'Alarm' not in currAlarmNames:
				newAlarmName = 'Alarm'
			else:
				validNameFound = 0
				x = 1
				while validNameFound == 0:
					newAlarmName = 'Alarm ' + str(x)
					if newAlarmName not in currAlarmNames:
						validNameFound = 1
					else:
						x = x + 1
		
		else:
			alarms = []	
		
			newAlarmName = 'Alarm'
		
		# create new alarm object and append to alarms list, then sort the list by name and
		# send a message to updateAlarms, which updates the alarm list in the tag config
		newAlarm = {'name':newAlarmName}
		alarms.append(newAlarm)
		newAlarms = sorted(alarms, key=lambda k: k['name'])
		system.perspective.sendMessage("updateAlarms", payload = {'alarms':newAlarms}, scope = "page")
		
		# after creating the new alarm, select the new row in the alarm list that corresponds
		# to this alarm (so that the user can begin modifying the properties of the new alarm);
		# also, update the selected row in the alarm-configurator view with updateSelectedRow
		alarmIndex = findAlarmIndex(newAlarms,newAlarmName)
		selectedRow = self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow
		
		if selectedRow != alarmIndex:
			system.perspective.sendMessage("updateSelectedRow", payload = {'row':alarmIndex}, scope = "page")
			
			time.sleep(0.15)
			self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow = alarmIndex
			self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedColumn = 'name'
			logger.debug('alarm list selected row updating for new alarm; new selectedRow= ' + str(alarmIndex))

# retrieve the alarm to be deleted and see if we are allowed to remove it
	
	selectedRow = self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow
	if selectedRow != None:
		# get name of alarm to be deleted, get names of UDT alarms and add them to a list
		alarmName = self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarm List").props.data[selectedRow].name
		udtAlarmNames = []
		for udtAlarm in self.view.params.udtDefAlarms:
			udtAlarmNames.append(udtAlarm['name'])
		
		# if the alarm to be deleted is a UDT alarm, then it cannot be removed,
		# show a warning popup to the user
		if alarmName in udtAlarmNames:
			system.perspective.openPopup("udt-warning",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'title':'Error','body':'This alarm cannot be deleted because it is defined in the UDT definition.','id':'udt-warning'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
		else:
			# set selectedRow to None and send a message to removeAlarm, which finds the alarm
			# in the tagConfig alarm list and deletes it
			logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.lg.delete')
			logger.debug('alarm removed; alarm name= ' + str(alarmName) + '; tagpath= ' + self.view.params.tagConfig['path'])
			
			system.perspective.sendMessage("updateSelectedRow", payload = {'row':None}, scope = "page")
			self.parent.parent.getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow = None
		
			system.perspective.sendMessage("removeAlarm", payload = {'name':alarmName}, scope = "page")

def sanitizeTree(element):
		"""
		A custom deep copy functon for dicts/lists that converts
			the Perspective property object wrappers to the
			Python equivalent.
			
		Args:
			element: The Perspective property object wrapper.
		
		Returns:
			A deep copy (Python equivalent) of the Perspective
			property object wrapper passed in (element).
		"""
		if hasattr(element, '__iter__'):
			if hasattr(element, 'keys'):
				return dict((k, sanitizeTree(element[k])) for k in element.keys())
			else:
				return list(sanitizeTree(x) for x in element)
		return element
		
	def containsAssociatedData(alarm):
		"""
		Checks to see if the alarm has any associated data properties, and if it
			does, creates list of the names of the associated data properties.
			
		Args:
			alarm: The alarm object being searched.
			
		Returns:
			A tuple in which the first element is False if the alarm does not
			have any associated data properties, or True if the alarm does
			have associated data prperties, and in which the second element
			is a list that is empty if the alarm does not have associated data 
			properties, or it contains the name of the associated data
			propertie(s) (if the alarm has at least one).
		"""
		builtInProperties = {'name','enabled','priority','timestampSource',
								'label','displayPath','ackMode','notes','ackNotesReqd',
								'shelvingAllowed','mode','setpointA','inclusiveA','anyChange',
								'setpointB','inclusiveB','bitPosition','bitOnZero','isActive',
								'deadband','deadbandMode','timeOnDelaySeconds','timeOffDelaySeconds',
								'ackPipeline','activePipeline','clearPipeline','voip_customMessage',
								'CustomEmailMessage','CustomEmailSubject','CustomSmsMessage','activeCondition'}
		if set(alarm.keys()).issubset(builtInProperties) == True:
			return (False,[])
		else:
			# return a list of associated data props
			return (True,[prop for prop in alarm.keys() if prop not in builtInProperties])
	
	# after making changes to alarms for the tag, time to commit the changes
	config = sanitizeTree(self.view.params.tagConfig)
	if len(config.keys()) == 0:
		system.perspective.openPopup("commit-warning",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'title':'Error','body':'No tag selected.','id':'commit-warning'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
	else:
		# when editing the mode of an alarm, the 'display name' of the property is saved in the
		# local tagConfig rather than the 'underlying name'; so, if the mode of any alarms was
		# edited, change the 'display name' to 'underlying name' before sending changes to 
		# system.tag.configure
		alarmModeMap = {None:'Equality','Not Equal':'Inequality','Equal':'Equality', 'Below Setpoint':'BelowValue','Above Setpoint':'AboveValue', 'Between Setpoints':'BetweenValues', 'Outside Setpoints':'OutsideValues','Out of range':'OutOfEngRange','Bad Quality':'BadQuality','Any Change':'AnyChange','Bit State':'Bit','On Condition':'OnCondition'}
		
		# get the parent path of the tag
		tagPath = config['path']
		pathParts = tagPath.split(']')
		provider = pathParts[0] + ']'
		pathParts = pathParts[1].split('/')
		parentPath = provider
		for i in range(0,len(pathParts)-1):
			parentPath = parentPath + pathParts[i] + '/'
		
		if '/' in parentPath:
			parentPath = parentPath[:-1]

		# get the full current config of the tag and clear out the alarms list
		currConfig = system.tag.getConfiguration(tagPath)[0]
		currConfig['alarms'] = []
		
		canSave = True
				
		# correcting the mode and changing voip_customMessage back to 
		# voip.customMessage if any of the alarms have this property
		for alarm in config['alarms']:
			if 'mode' in alarm.keys():
				oldMode = str(alarm['mode'])
				alarm['mode'] = alarmModeMap[oldMode]
			if 'voip_customMessage' in alarm.keys():				
				alarm['voip.customMessage'] = alarm['voip_customMessage']
				del alarm['voip_customMessage']
			
			associatedData = containsAssociatedData(alarm)
			if associatedData[0]:
				for associatedDataProp in associatedData[1]:
					if alarm[associatedDataProp] == None:
						canSave = False
						break
			
			currConfig['alarms'].append(alarm)
		
		if canSave:				
			logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.lg.commit')
			logger.debug('commit pressed; new config= ' + str(currConfig) + '; parentpath= ' + str(parentPath))
			
			# call system.tag.configure with parent path to commit the changes
			results = system.tag.configure(parentPath,currConfig,'o')
			
			# get the result of the configure, display a popup containing the results, and refresh the tagConfig
			
			body = 'Tag edit successful!'
			
			if str(results[0]) == 'Good':
				body = 'Tag edit successful!'
				system.perspective.openPopup("commit",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'body':body,'id':'commit'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
				system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTagConfig", payload = {}, scope = "page")
			else:
				body = 'Tag edit failed'
				system.perspective.openPopup("commit",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Edit Failed Popup', params = {'body':body,'id':'commit','error':results.toString()},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
		else:
			body = 'Unsupported data type detected. Please make these changes in the Designer.'
			system.perspective.openPopup("commit",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'body':body,'id':'commit'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)

# reverting any alarm changes that the user made; setting selectedRow of alarm list to none,
	# refresh the tagConfig (via send message to refreshTagConfig), and update the params that
	# are passed to the binding editor (via send message to updateBindingEditor)
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.lg.revert')
	logger.debug('revert button pressed; setting selectedRow=None for alarm list and refreshing binding on tagConfig')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateSelectedRow", payload = {'row':None}, scope = "page")
	self.parent.parent.parent.getChild("Alarms").getChild("Alarm Container").getChild("Alarm List").props.selection.selectedRow = None
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTagConfig", payload = {}, scope = "page")
	
	payload = {'name':'','prop':{},'displayName':''}
			
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateBindingEditor", payload = payload, scope = "page")
